card: P2 — deeper prompt/tool/cache economy only when attributable
head: c8410316b4d3a1315f4e42cfe8d625fcc800b576

method.what: a real Engine on a throwaway workspace and home, default doctrine and skills, one scripted request; the system prompt as sent, split at its `# Environment` block
notMeasured: cache hit rate — needs repeated real requests inside the provider's retention window
the order a provider hashes tools, instructions and input in
what the stable session key is worth in tokens

reading.withinOneProcess: the environment block is computed once, so the whole prompt is the same request after request
reading.acrossAProcess: the block is computed again (date, git status snapshot, recent commits); 9,303 bytes of stable system text, and everything a provider orders after the system prompt, sit past the first byte that can differ
reading.notChanged: the order. Moving the block last would extend the reusable prefix by at most 9,303 bytes on the first request after a resume, and only inside the provider's retention window — unmeasured, against a recorded regression the last time a prefix block was moved (engine.ts, the narrative profile).
